description: Scan a file or directory (text, CSV, JSON, logs, SQL, .xlsx, .docx, text-based PDF; up to 100 MB each) for personal data — identifiers (NIK, KK, NPWP, phone, email, bank account, BPJS, passport, SIM, NIP, card, plate, IP, coordinates), names, addresses, birth dates, and UU PDP categories (religion, marital status, gender, nationality, health, finances, criminal records, biometrics) — without revealing it: findings show only partially masked values. Also lists files and pages it could not scan (scanned or encrypted PDFs, .xls, .doc, images, archives). Use before reading data files and before committing fixtures or seeders.

path.description: File or directory, relative to the project root

name: scan_pii
title: Scan files for Indonesian personal data
